text: ANDREY worlds-v2 feedback (live board review): (1) BIRDS-EYE nodes too EMPTY with tiny titles — content not adequate; W0 must show sensible/adequate content, not empty giants. (2) closer = tasks too TRANSPARENT — wrong; content should be solid/readable, transparency is not the answer. (3) DONE tasks: NOT opacity-dim — Andrey meant LOWER IN HIERARCHY (move down/deprioritize spatially, done sink to bottom), redefine §24.5/§25.6. (4) SIZE: NOT make-huge — grow in BOTH width AND height within BOUNDS, proportional to content (text len + #strides); birds-eye must not be empty giants. (5) STRIDES (decisions) shown as squares now → make CIRCLES in a row connected by ONE line (snake/Thread&Coil), zoomable, signal you can zoom in. (6) zoom into stride-circles reveals text + more info + internal idea structure. (7) BUG: canvas text not selectable/copyable anywhere. (8) clicking a plan section should NAVIGATE to its task(s). (9) when close on plan, want go-to-task / go-to-spec buttons + more interactivity. (10) handoff checkpoint canvas render (§27.4 timeline marker) needs building + showing per his vision. NO band-aids/legacy/hardcode — structure the logic.
W0 must be a filled dashboard, not an empty tile: title/status, 2-line digest, task/stride counts, coverage/progress bars, mini section/task rows, stride snake preview, and latest-change chip.
W0 is a filled dashboard: title/status, digest, progress bars, mini section/task rows, stride snake preview, latest-change chip; no empty giant boxes.
Status hierarchy is spatial: in_progress rises to top/front; done sinks to a bottom shelf and later order, but remains fully opaque and selectable.
Footprint = bounded content-driven reserve from textLen, strideCount, subtaskCount, rationale; width tiers plus height curve, recomputed only on data mutation.
Strides are circular beads on one continuous snake line; zooming into a bead reveals a stride-world with heading, body, links, provenance.
Selectable text uses user-select islands plus pointer intent split; text drag selects, chrome/empty board pans.
Handoff renders as an orchestrator timeline lane with reset coins, chronological spine, expansion, provenance chips, pending pulse.
Channels orthogonalized (v2 spine): SPATIAL-Y=hierarchy, PAINT-band=detail, COLOR=identity/status/kind, OPACITY=transient focus-assist ONLY. No channel does two jobs.

[pt4] Two-axis bounded size — width QUANTIZED to 1-3 column slots by volume thresholds (cols stay stable); height continuous clamp(baseH+Hk*sqrt(volume), aspectFloor=0.62*W, maxH). aspectFloor kills hollow letterboxes; recompute on data mutation only, never zoom.

[pt7] Selectable text via CSS pointer/select split — .ct-canvas-text{user-select:text}+data-canvas-selectable; pan onMouseDown skips drag when target.closest(selectable); container stays user-select:none. Root cause body{user-select:none}+container userSelect:none. Rejected synced overlay.

[pt2] Transparency banned as a signal — primary body always opacity 1.0; remove TaskCard chrome.dim + secondary-opacity on body; opacity reserved only for transient dominance soft-dim of UNRELATED neighbors.

[pt3] Done SINKS / in_progress RISES — band sort (statusRank, band, createdAt, id); flip animates ~300ms slot move, changed band recomputed downward, camera untouched; done gets recessed surface (depth not opacity).

[pt5] Stride snake is SERPENTINE (boustrophedon) circles on ONE svg path, coil-on-loop with iter badge; freshest at head pulses, done coils to tail; W0 dots+line, W1 +titles, W2 +mini-cards, W3 inner world.
[pt6] Stride = leaf micro-world, own appW bands s0 dot -> s3 bloom (heading/body/links), reversible by zoom, no click/modal; bloom reserved inside task bbox, scroll node-only.
[pt8] Section-row click flies+blinks covering tasks (uncovered->add-task); spec block click flies to linked plan row via spec_links; user-initiated so camera move OK (31).
[pt9] Close-band W2/W3 interactive layer — per-row ->task/->spec ghost buttons + header Focus/open-pane; camera motion user-click ONLY; live changes use off-screen edge signal (31.2).

WORLDS v2 SYNTHESIZED → §32 (opus 0d781608 + codex f4b0f9cc converged, 17+ strides each). SPINE: orthogonalize 4 channels — SPATIAL-Y=hierarchy (in_progress rises/done sinks via shelves+sort, NOT opacity), PAINT-band=detail (§26 W0-W3), COLOR=identity, OPACITY=transient-focus-ONLY (content always 1.0). W0 = compressed dense content (digest+counters+snake+coverage), never hollow. Two-axis bounded size with aspectFloor=0.62W (kills letterboxes), grows by volume(text+strides+subtasks), recompute on data only. Strides = serpentine snake of kind-colored circles, each a leaf micro-world (s0-s3), bloom on zoom. Selectable text = CSS pointer/select split (no overlay). Section-click flies+blinks to tasks; W2/W3 go-to-task/spec buttons (user-click only §31). Handoff = orchestrator-region timeline lane of coins. Committed design §32. Ready for FE dispatch.

ANDREY (UI bug, fold into §32): TASK TITLES OVERFLOW the card right edge (clip out of bounds) — see U1/U2/U4. Title must truncate/ellipsize or wrap WITHIN the fixed frame, never overflow (§22.1 content-fits-frame). Fix in the worlds-v2 lane.

ANDREY (§32.10): tasks form a tall портянka column again. FIX: tasks SMALLER than spec/plan (base ~1/2, >=2x smaller, bounded growth still applies — zoom-drill gives detail, so small base is fine). Layout = CLOUD to the RIGHT of the plan (2D multi-column cluster, not a tall column); vertical axis = priority/status: TOP=highest-priority+in_progress, BOTTOM=done (done sinks, composes §32.3). Bounded region, overflow flows rightward into more columns, never infinite vertical strip. Deterministic stable packing, ~300ms slot anim, §31 no camera move.

CONFIRMED batch.rs apply_batch atomicity violation — UpsertSpec/UpsertSpecSection/SetSpecSectionBody/CreatePlanFromSpec call store methods that persist immediately, NOT into the rolled-back working clone; later op failure rolls back plan but leaks created spec/plan. batch_is_atomic test only covers task ops.

Arc-replacement lost-update — reload_from_disk/load_file_into_index/save replace plans-map Arc while concurrent with_plan mutates the OLD arc; disk write wins but in-memory map points at stale reloaded arc until next reload. Needs external-edit + daemon-mutation race. Needs concurrency test.

prepare_handoff_reseed TOCTOU — reject_active_reseed_for_pane scans in a separate pass BEFORE the with_plan that sets reseed_pending; two concurrent reseeds for same pane can both pass then both set pending. Low (CLI-driven).
plan_handoff.rs provider_command_for_reseed takes svc.mux.write() for read-only get_pane on the reseed path (plan.rs pane_role uses read()). Contention on top-of-hierarchy mux lock, not corruption.

SOLID merge_plan_hits 0-plan-hits overfetch — score ordering matches mem search (lower=better), rescue guarantees >=1 plan hit, no dup, final len<=limit. related_units never panics on dangling targets. handle dedup prevents body-file path collisions.
tsc clean; all canvas tsx unit tests green (layout/taskBands/cards/CanvasView + others); §32.9 Playwright matrix authored (canvas-worlds-v2.spec.ts) — orchestrator runs it as the gate

§32.10 task CLOUD right of plan — small tiles (156x84 base, ≈half section-node), 2D column-major fill bounded by cloudMaxH, overflow rightward; vertical axis = status/priority (active top, done bottom); ~300ms slot animation; maxScale 4 for zoom-drill to W3

§32.1-32.4 shipped — orthogonal channels (opacity removed from primary text), W0 compressed (digest+counters+stride-snake preview / section rows+counts), done SINKS via cloudSort shelfRank+recessed surface, two-axis bounded footprint with aspect floor (taskFootprint.ts)

VERIFIED+INTEGRATED by gate (c94c383f): §32 worlds-v2 — StrideSnake + HandoffCoin (new), orthogonal channels (Y=hierarchy/done-sinks, opacity=transient-only), bounded 2-axis size, W0 dense, §32.10 task-cloud, title-overflow fix, selectable text, section-nav. tsc clean, 14 canvas tsx tests green, vite build ok. §32.9 Playwright authored.
